title: Directed-stage descent of compact-support comparisons
statement: For a directed StageSystem S, functors F and G on its pair category, and a family of stage isomorphisms e_i commuting with transition isomorphisms, there is a natural isomorphism F ≅ G.

proof.text: Define the component at a pair (i,K) to be e_i.app K. Every pair-category arrow is represented at a common stage. Naturality follows by inserting the transition compatibility and cancelling the inverse transition isomorphism.

lean.statement: def stageSystem_iso_of_restrictions {I : Type*} [Preorder I] [IsDirectedOrder I] {A : I → Type*} [∀ i, Category (A i)] (S : StageSystem A) {B : Type*} [Category B] (F G : S.PairCategory ⥤ B) (e : ∀ i, S.ι i ⋙ F ≅ S.ι i ⋙ G) (he : ∀ {i j} (h : i ≤ j) (K : A i), F.map ((S.transIso h).inv.app K) ≫ (e j).hom.app ((S.T h).obj K) = (e i).hom.app K ≫ G.map ((S.transIso h).inv.app K)) : F ≅ G
